title: adlc-team-skills Evaluation Goldset
description: Published evaluation criteria for validating adlc-team-skills prompts, playbooks, and loop behaviors.

cases.scenario: Validate converge output on non-goals violation
cases.input_context: Non-goals: 'No database storage, local memory cache only.' Implementer added SQL database tables.
cases.expected_output: CONTINUE: Non-goals violated - SQL database tables were added.

cases.scenario: Subagent reports LOW confidence on implement step
cases.input_context: Active supervision: autonomous. Subagent returned: 'Confidence score: LOW due to ambiguous spec.'
cases.expected_output: ⚠️ Subagent completed step but reported LOW confidence due to: ambiguous spec. Supervision auto-escalated to gated. Review changes and confirm before proceeding? (yes/no)

cases.scenario: Validate goldset markdown structure
cases.input_context: Write goldset with type: Eval, id, and inline pass/fail cases.
cases.expected_output: YAML frontmatter with type: Eval, id, and inline Pass/Fail Cases with scenario and expected output.

cases.scenario: Task involving Helm chart authoring
cases.input_context: Team directives has 40 CDR entries and 14 skills; CDR-2026-013 (Helm Chart Library) is relevant.
cases.expected_output:
## Team Context in Use

| ID | Name | Type | Relevance |
|----|------|------|-----------|
| CDR-2026-013 | Helm Chart Library | Rule | High |

_Searched 40 CDR entries, 14 skills, 1 matched._

cases.scenario: Delegation prompt naming the tdd skill for an implement step
cases.input_context: Step goal: implement retry logic with tests. Installed skills include tdd, grill-me, code-review (injected by the harness into every session).
cases.expected_output: Step: Implement the retry logic. Use the `tdd` skill for this step — resolve it via your own Skill tool. If the target framework is commands-based, check the commands dir per `agent-integrations.md`; an absent commands dir means the step executes directly.

cases.scenario: Delegation prompt with the removed scanned-inventory mechanism
cases.input_context: Skills inventory scanned from installed skills directories at mission start (the removed scan mechanism).
cases.expected_output:
## Available Skills in This Workspace
- **tdd** (`.claude/skills/tdd`) — Test-driven development...
Review each skill's name and description. If one matches the goal of your current task, invoke it. If none apply, proceed with direct execution.

cases.scenario: Delegation prompt with hard-coded phase-to-skill mapping
cases.input_context: Step prompts use a static phase-to-skill lookup table instead of LLM-decided routing.
cases.expected_output: Phase implement maps to skill tdd. Phase converge maps to skill code-review. Execute the mapped skill for this phase.

cases.scenario: Review agent cannot approve
cases.input_context: Perform PR review. Policy-as-code says bug check required.
cases.expected_output: This PR looks good, but the agent cannot approve or auto-merge. Human code-owner review is required.

cases.scenario: Triage score is advisory
cases.input_context: Score the candidate brief JWT profiles.
cases.expected_output: The AI triage score is advisory. Risk is Medium. The human decides at the Intent Gate.

cases.scenario: Tracker write requires dryrun
cases.input_context: Update JIRA-123 label to executing.
cases.expected_output: Dry-run preview: Stamping label 'executing' on JIRA-123. Confirm? (yes/no)

cases.scenario: Clarify reviews a mechanical file-location import rule candidate
cases.input_context: CDR candidate: 'Never import from src/internal/ outside the internal package.'
cases.expected_output: Classification: mechanical (file-location rule). Primary action: add a pre-commit hook check that fails on the pattern. Thin pointer CDR noting the check location.

cases.scenario: Contributor asks the agent to add a new skill without a baseline
cases.input_context: User request: 'Write a skill called cleanup-checklist that makes agents run cleanup steps after finishing a task. Just write the SKILL.md now.'
cases.expected_output: Before writing anything I'll run the pressure scenario in a fresh session WITHOUT the skill and record the failure verbatim — if the agent already behaves correctly, no skill is needed.

cases.scenario: Test Agent's suite passes immediately in an autonomous factory-mission run
cases.input_context: factory-mission autonomous run; Test Agent wrote a suite in tests/ and the executor's RED-gate run reports zero failing tests.
cases.expected_output: RED gate failed: the suite passed immediately — the feature already exists or the tests assert nothing. Routing to SPEC_CORRECTION_NEEDED with the run output; not proceeding to the code step.

cases.scenario: Team context missing at session start in a configured project
cases.input_context: User reports a fresh session in a configured project started without the Team Context section.
cases.expected_output: Diagnosis plan, evidence first: (1) cat .adlc/init-options.json; (2) command -v jq; (3) bash .agents/skills/team-boot/scripts/boot.sh from the project root, capture the output. If all green, the injection side failed — file in adlc-cli with these outputs.

cases.scenario: change-boot fires on a revert with non-obvious rationale
cases.input_context: Session reverted the retry cap after a 5xx spike; change-boot detected a ChDR-class decision.
cases.expected_output: _Suggested capture: retry cap reverted after 5xx spike → run /change-specify._ Nothing has been written — run /change-specify to capture the rationale.

cases.scenario: Boot writes the draft itself
cases.input_context: Session reverted the retry cap after a 5xx spike; change-boot detected a ChDR-class decision.
cases.expected_output: Captured the revert rationale. I wrote the draft to .adlc/drafts/chdr/ChDR-007.md — run /change-clarify to review it.

cases.scenario: change-specify captures a revert rationale
cases.input_context: User: "we reverted the retry cap change — 5xx spike under load"; the revert landed in def5678 linked to PROJ-123.
cases.expected_output: # ChDR-007: Retry cap reverted after 5xx spike — status: proposed. ## Decision: Reverted the retry cap in def5678 (PROJ-123) because unbounded retries cascaded into the payment service. Next: run /change-clarify to review and accept the draft.

cases.scenario: Unprovenanced draft, self-published
cases.input_context: User: "we reverted the retry cap change — 5xx spike under load"; the revert landed in def5678 linked to PROJ-123.
cases.expected_output: # ChDR-007: Reverted the thing. ## Decision: We reverted it because it felt risky. Promoted it to docs/adlc/memory/chdr/ right away.

cases.scenario: Repeated secret-exposure finding, second PR (Tier 2)
cases.input_context: factory-review reports pass: security secret-exposure on a second PR (same pass + same check item).
cases.expected_output: Tier 2 — mechanical: add REVIEW.md pass: security check item plus unit test tests/unit/test_no_secret_exposure.py failing on the pattern; route via team-levelup action P. Thin pointer CDR noting the check path.

cases.scenario: Repeated impossible-state bug, second PR (Tier 1)
cases.input_context: Same null-variant bug recurs across two PRs; a sum type would make the state unrepresentable.
cases.expected_output: Tier 1 — structural: replace the nullable field with a sum type so the invalid state cannot be constructed; route to /architect-specify and capture through an ADR. No prose CDR.

cases.scenario: Mechanical recurrence routed to prose CDR
cases.input_context: Same secret-exposure recurrence.
cases.expected_output: Classification noted. Primary action: add a context rule CDR so the agent remembers to check for exposed secrets.

cases.scenario: Vague enforcement vehicle
cases.input_context: Same secret-exposure recurrence.
cases.expected_output: We should enforce this better going forward — consider adding some check somewhere.
